_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S4 (Joolz/M&P/Mima). Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json. This is the SAME stroller as joolz-geo2, configured in DOUBLE mode; specs shared except weight/seat count/adapters.
name: Joolz Geo2 (Double Mode)

clekListed.clekRow: Joolz Geo2 (Double Mode) — Geo2 Upper + Geo2 lower car seat adapter (414001 & 414002) — *lowest-position caveat

specs._weightNote: ~36 lb in double configuration (30 lb single chassis + second seat/adapters). Same frame as joolz-geo2.
specs._dimsNote: Same one-piece fold footprint as single; second seat/carrycot stacks on the frame.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: from birth (twin/duo: two carrycots, two car seats, or two seats)

safety.standards: EN 1888 (Joolz). Clek's official list attests the model was tested to the applicable ASTM stroller/car-seat standard for Liing use.
safety.notes: 5-point harness each seat; main seat 3-position recline (lie-flat), second seat 2 positions. In duo/double config the lower seat/car seat/carrycot occupies the basket space (no shopping basket). Clek notes a lowest-position caveat with a car seat fitted.

specs.recline: main seat 3 positions incl. lie-flat; second seat 2 positions
specs.tires: 7 in front / 12 in rear (18 cm / 30 cm) EVA foam-coated wheels; all-wheel suspension

notes: Same physical stroller as joolz-geo2, in double/duo configuration. To carry the Liing in double mode Clek requires BOTH the Geo2 Upper (adapter-414001) AND Geo2 Lower (adapter-414002) car seat adapters. Second seat and lower adapter are add-on accessories (not included with the base chassis). ~36 lb; not the city/portability goal but on Clek's list. *Lowest-position caveat.
